title: The Armorer in Exile
description: The Mandalorian stumbles through the streets of the ringworld, Glavis. Taking a lift up to retrieve his reward, he learns the location of an access shaft to the substrata. Heading down Kolzoc Alley, he spies a hidden Mandalorian insignia, and enters through the door behind it. Working his way down the pathway, he finds the Armorer below. She instructs Paz Vizsla to help with Mando's wounded leg, and the two have a pleasant reunion.
